Minor ambiguity: the note's broad 'materials for our developer booth' could alternatively sweep the tape in as an event material (fully deducted, reimbursed would then be 106.98); either reading keeps the case subtle_multi.
Line 2 (USB-C MIDI adapter EUR 89.90, unit EUR 44.95) is reimbursable in full with VAT (106.98) under Ch 10 peripherals rule (unit price under EUR 100, no IT ticket needed).
Invoice dated 2024-03-29 (Good Friday, DE public holiday) does not trigger the Ch 13 weekend flowchart: Ch 9 states 'Commercial invoices for goods (Chapter 10) are never weekend expenses.'
